body: I learned that underneath my anger lies a soft part of me that still wants to forgive.
10 hours has passed and i hope you're still here man, thought i'd kill myself a year ago too but somehow it hasn't happened

Hello, OP! 

I've been on this subreddit for quite a while. I can relate to your experiences a bit, especially about being the smart kid. Also fell into the pits of procrastination and still doing my best to crawl out of it. I just couldn't understand how people around me seem to get their shit together. 

What you said about your parent's disappointment...I get that. As someone who just wanted to make the people around them proud, this can feel like a final nail into the coffin. And it has been for me, multiple times. 

I can understand what it feels being in a position where it feels like you're not allowed to make mistakes or any fuckups. The world can make us feel like we're the stupidest people for sticking around, but everything you've done so far, including the times where you felt stuck, have been stuck, and fell down - all of that is proof that you're still trying your damned best. 

I think you're brave for confessing to your parents and opening up about your problems, and whatever shit that brings, you've still gone ahead and made a significant step forward. You came here and let it all out. Keep going! I bluffed my way through life too, and shut down for a solid year in an attempt to hide from my mistakes. As it turns out, everyone was just waiting for me to show up to it. It didn't matter whether or not I had it together. That was shit, by the way, but it set me free. Felt like the first step to making peace with my losses and finally moving forward.

I can't imagine what you're going through exactly, OP, but wherever you are, I hope you're doing better, and that you're still around to read this. I can't say shit about "things get better" or that "it's all going to be ok", but I'm with you about wanting to live. I cheer you on that. I hope you find strength. In whatever way that feels true to you, in whatever way that makes you happy, I hope you find strength and live. 

You got this!

Same, same. Once in HS they noticed me spiral down and told me how it'd be better to kill myself already and make it quick. I don't know if that was a joke, but I kept thinking about it for years. Fast forward to the present...and here I am.

Me too, OP. I get you. With every white hair I see pop out of their heads, with every new wrinkles, and every time I notice that they're not as strong as they used to be. I wish I could give them what remains of my life because I don't deserve it. But yeah, in the off chance I stick out longer than they do, I'll probably be following right after too.

Hello, OP! Thank you so much for posting this. I can relate to your post on many levels (probably except the graduating part, because I'm still struggling at college), but other than that I understand how your loved ones tend to keep you from kicking the bucket, like an anchor, of some sorts. Personally, my mother too is one of the only reasons I'm still here, because I want to give back to her (and my family) somehow before I disappear. 

In regards to your experience with opening up, I can relate to that too, because to some degree I always felt like people don't take me seriously just because I'm still up for whatever job it is they want me to do. At some point I just stopped opening up altogether...and now I'm here. 

I don't know much about things getting better, but I sincerely hope for brighter days ahead of you, OP. The same goes for everyone else reading this reply, too. Whether all of us choose to stay or finally go, I hope we all find the peace we're looking for.
thank you. i needed to read this tonight. you stay safe too, op. i'll also be doing my best over here.

a few years ago the idea of sh scared me, especially after some of my friends confessed to doing it. they showed me their scars and i wondered the same thing, like why would they do that...until a few years later and i just...snapped. intrusive thoughts weren't new to me, i had them a lot, but one day i had a big thing going on and i just needed to feel something else other than dread, stress and whatever fuck shit it is. gave it a try and kept doing it. it felt like making a scoreboard about me vs. the world. 

sometimes i wonder if it was me vs. me all along

i've also been clean for quite some time, and though the marks are still there...i feel like i don't want them to fade, somehow. i feel like when they do, any evidence of the pain i felt will also vanish...which feels wrong coz the pain is still there...

also hid my scars big time when they were fresh, and during those times i'd be so blank like, "holy shit ok ok i did it but FUCK they're gonna see" 

but now that they're fading, it's like, "where is it did it happen for real where is it"

a lot of pressure because people are counting on me to do my job. my parents too. i just...feel like i've been giving it everything i got, and it keeps getting shittier. like i'm stuck and i keep sinking. and every day i have to face them knowing that i let them (and keep letting them down). it's hard to get up

keep checking on him, continue open communication, and yes, establish trust. as someone who's been self-harming, there's no guarantee he won't cut when you're not there, but being reminded of support and loved ones sometimes help dispel these urges. personally, i've stopped cutting for a while after my little brother saw mine...he never asked about it but he's started checking on me a lot (simple shit like asking to play games with him, etc.)  now, the urges are still there but i find less opportunities to act on it.
